```yaml
name: Remove experimental decorators

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  remove-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install gh CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gh

      - name: Run decorator removal script and create PR
        run: |
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE" >&2
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected. Exiting."
            exit 0
          fi
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only)
          BRANCH=automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S)
          git checkout -b $BRANCH
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Remove experimental decorators"
          git push --set-upstream origin $BRANCH
          cat <<EOF > /tmp/pr_body.txt
          This PR removes experimental decorators from the codebase.

          Changed files:
          $CHANGED_FILES
          EOF
          gh pr create --title "Remove experimental decorators" --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt --label automated
```
